user_constraint: 现有数据是全部资源；不再补采；无法用现有证据验证的条目明确关闭，不继续等待。
candidate_universe: Exactly four named restricted candidates. No expansion, alias mining, new tolerance or whitelist after this declaration.

candidate_support_floor.official_only_boundary: Pure official semantic constraints are source-governed separately; applying this dataset to calibrate them creates an empirical component subject to these floors.

gate_origin: Reuse pre-existing P2/P3 support floors and engineering screen, not prior effects; these are research admission criteria and not statistical validation or detection metrics.
group_aggregation: Any counterexample -> COUNTEREXAMPLE; otherwise any UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN; otherwise any MATCH -> MATCH; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE. Agreement denominator MATCH + COUNTEREXAMPLE. UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE never positive support.
selection_order: Freeze discovery shortlist before opening development rows; development cannot rescue discovery rejection.

fixed_conditions.model: Exact normalized model token with explicit Build marker; optional explicit locale only. No alias table or substring matching.
fixed_conditions.gpu: Five literal hardware renderer families; software fallback excluded, unknown families never match each other.
fixed_conditions.screen: Sorted two-dimensional residual <=1 CSS pixel, fixed arithmetic candidate. No post-hoc status-bar correction, 10% threshold or learned tolerance.

not_identifiable: replay or attack status from native-field absence
virtual environment identity without independent ground truth
closure_policy: Every outstanding NEEDS_RESEARCH/NEEDS_DATA item becomes ACTIVE, DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY or CLOSED_UNVERIFIABLE; no collection request and no pending loop.
